question: Two charges $7 \, \mu\text{C}$ and $-2 \, \mu\text{C}$ are placed at positions $(-9 \text{ cm}, 0, 0)$ and $(9 \text{ cm}, 0, 0)$ respectively in an external electric field $E = A(1/r^2)$, where $A = 9 \times 10^5 \text{ C m}^{-2}$.
